characters.description: A kind girl mistreated by her stepfamily who wishes for joy and freedom.
characters.name: Cinderella

characters.description: Cinderella's jealous stepmother who forces her to work and blocks her from the ball.
characters.name: Stepmother

characters.description: Cinderella's mean stepsisters who mock her and compete for the prince's attention.
characters.name: Stepsisters

characters.description: A magical being who helps Cinderella attend the ball.
characters.name: Fairy Godmother
goals: help Cinderella attend the royal ball

characters.description: The royal prince who falls for Cinderella and searches for her after the ball.
characters.name: Prince

continuity_constraints: Cinderella must be mistreated by her stepfamily but remain kind.
She must receive magical help to attend the royal ball.
She must leave at midnight and lose a glass slipper.
The prince must search using the slipper and find her.
Cinderella must forgive her stepfamily and achieve happiness.

important_entities.description: A delicate shoe left behind by Cinderella at midnight.
important_entities.narrative_role: Key object used by the prince to identify Cinderella.
important_entities.name: glass slipper

important_entities.description: A grand celebration hosted by the royal family.
important_entities.narrative_role: Setting where Cinderella and the prince meet.
important_entities.name: royal ball

important_entities.description: A carriage magically transformed from a pumpkin.
important_entities.name: pumpkin carriage

important_entities.description: The Fairy Godmother's tool for casting spells.
important_entities.name: magic wand

relationships.description: Stepmother mistreats Cinderella and keeps her from the ball.
Fairy Godmother magically helps Cinderella attend the ball.
Prince falls in love with Cinderella and seeks her through the glass slipper.
Stepmother favors her daughters and schemes for their success.

world_rules.rule: The glass slipper fits only Cinderella.
Fairy Godmother's magic can temporarily transform objects and animals.
The royal ball is a high-status event where the prince seeks a bride.
Kindness and forgiveness lead to a happy resolution.
